main_text.head: EXPOSTVLATIO PVERI IESV CVM HOMINE SVAPTE CVLPA PEREVNTE: Def. Erasmo Roterodamo autore.
DESCRIPTA EX BASILIENSI editione Anni 1519.

p.i: Cum mihi sint uni bona, quæ vel frondea tellus, Vel Olympus ingens continet, Dicite, mortales, quæ vos dementia cepit? Hæc aucupari ut unde vis Malitiis, quàm de proprio deposcere fonte, Adeo benigno & obvio? Mendacesq; juvet, trepido miseroq; tumultu, Umbras bonorum persequi? Pauci me, qui sum vera largitor & auctor Felicitatis, expetant? Forma rapit multos: me nil formosius usquam est: Formam ardet hanc nemo tamen. Suspiciunt ceras antiquaq; stemmata multi: At me quid est illustrius? Ut qui sim genitore Deo, Deus ipse, profectus, Genitrice natus virgine. Unde fit, ut mecum vix gestiat unus & alter Affinitatem jungere?

page.notes: Red underlining in the poem (under "mortales", "vera largitor & auctor", "Felicitatis") is a reader's mark, not printed text, and is left out. "Def." in the title line is hard to read and may be "Des."; it is copied as it appears. The poem is set in italic throughout. The "Maxi-" catchword is the first word of the next page. Some words on the scan are blurred and were read as printed, with no [?] needed. Lines are shown as printed; Latin u/v and i/j are normalised.
